title: CSCI 462 — Introduction to Cryptography
subject: Cybersecurity
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Define the core components of cryptographic systems, including confidentiality, integrity, and authentication.
Explain how mathematical foundations and standardized algorithms enable secure data protection.
Apply cryptographic principles to evaluate real-world security implementations and identify common vulnerabilities.
